notes: «[قال: حدثنا الحسين بن محمد بن الحسين بن مصعب ]» is printed in square brackets by the editor; it is read as written so the chain runs on, and this is flagged; the Imam is named only in the words after the chain (owner ruling 2); the Prophet who took his hand is the end, not a link
